exposure: Ambulance referral system dedicated to emergency obstetric care (EmOC)
outcome: Destination of referrals (health centers vs. hospital)
Incidence of major direct obstetric complications
cohort: Pregnant women in a rural area of Ethiopia who utilized an ambulance service for emergency obstetric care between July 1 and December 31, 2013.
finding: An ambulance service dedicated to EmOC in a rural Ethiopian setting facilitated referrals and optimized the use of local resources, with no maternal deaths recorded among users during the study period.
